title: PD Detection Models
summary: Multi-modal Parkinson's disease detection pipelines over spiral drawings, tremor signals and voice recordings, from a graduation project. SDV's synthesizers are run per class to rebalance a small clinical cohort.

title: Coginets
summary: A Python framework for training, optimising and deploying boosting regressors and classifiers, aimed at shortening the fit-and-ship loop. Its dataset helper is SDV: `src/dataset_creator.py` builds an `sdv.metadata.Metadata` and fits a `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` to manufacture datasets for testing and demonstration, with `sdv==1.17.1` pinned. SDV's copula synthesizer is called as the framework's data generator.

title: PrivORL
summary: The official implementation of PrivORL (NDSS 2026), which releases differentially private synthetic datasets for offline reinforcement learning so trajectories can be shared without exposing the behaviour policy. title: Infant skull-fracture ML

SDV's CTGAN is run as the augmentation behind a forensic clinical classifier.
